Definition: of Hebrew origin (H477); Elissæus, an Israelite:--Elissæus.
BiblicalUsage: Elissæus is an Israelite. The name appears in Luke (Luke 4:27). The life behind the name is told on the Elisha People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elissaîos matters because God knows His people by name, and Elissaîos is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
